name: Paws in Bloom
source:
Holly is a college grad on hard times, and life just won't seem to let up. After a long day of posting job fliers, she takes shelter from the oncoming rain in the Last Brew. Iris is just trying to finish her notes from classes that day, with only a few weeks left before finals. She is not in the mood to be dealing with other people's shenanigans. Sprinkle in a little coffee, clumsiness, and a corgi - and you've got a delightful recipe that'll tug at your heartstrings.  

[from [url=https://sirmiska.itch.io/paws-in-bloom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
霍莉是一名正值困难时期的大学毕业生，生活似乎不会放松。在张贴招聘传单一整天后，她在“最后的酿造”中避雨。艾丽丝正在努力完成当天的课堂笔记，距离期末考试仅剩几周了。她没心情去管别人的恶作剧。撒上一点咖啡、笨拙和一只柯基犬——你就得到了一个令人愉悦的食谱，会牵动你的心弦。

[来自[url=https://sirmiska.itch.io/paws-in-bloom]Itch.io[/url]]
